text:
Maria Lopez: Heads up — main e2e is red on CI after the merge of PR #4218. Failing consistently: allocator_integration_test::AllocShardSmoke on linux-x86. Can someone help bisect?

Ted Nguyen: On it. Is this reproducible locally or just CI?

Maria Lopez: Repro on CI only so far. Logs attached in pipeline, stack looks like an assertion in alloc_shard.cc: 'shard_size_consistent' around line 214.

infra-bot: Build 24321 failed: https://ci.redwood/integrations/24321 — alloc shard assert (job: linux-e2e) :rotating_light:

Priya Shah: I'll grab the last-green. Who merged #4218?

Maria Lopez: @Alex Kim merged it ~30m before the first failure. Link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4218

Alex Kim: Yep that was the allocator refactor + small syscall change. I added a guard in free path.

jonas-oncall: Can someone post the last-green commit hash so we can bisect between that and HEAD?

Ted Nguyen: Last green on main was commit 0a3b9f2 (about 3 hours ago). Current HEAD is 7f12d4c.

Priya Shah: I'll start a quick binary search with CIT2 label. Steps:
```
git checkout main
git bisect start 7f12d4c 0a3b9f2
# run the linux-e2e job script
```
I'll run bisect on a small set of commits first (only candidate PRs). Ping me if you want to pause merges.

Maria Lopez: Please hold merges into main until we get a bisect result. I'll add a code freeze note to #eng-releases.

Alex Kim: If it helps, my change touched allocator free path and syscalls. I can revert quickly if bisect points at my PR.

Ted Nguyen: Priya — how long for an initial bisect pass?

Priya Shah: Roughly 20-30m per pass since CI queue is light. Starting now.

(25m later)

Priya Shah: First pass finished. Bisect narrowed to commits between 4f9a2c and 7f12d4c. Suspects include PRs #4218 (Alex) and #4209 (external: perf tweaks).

Ted Nguyen: Can you try a cherry-pick test of just 4218 on top of last-green to see if it fails? That isolates Alex's change.

Priya Shah: Done — cherry-pick of #4218 onto 0a3b9f2 => re-run CI job.

infra-bot: Triggered rerun: https://ci.redwood/integrations/24346 (cherry-pick of PR #4218)

(12m later)

infra-bot: Build 24346 failed — same assert in allocator_integration_test::AllocShardSmoke

Priya Shah: Cherry-pick reproduces the failure. Seems likely related to #4218.

Alex Kim: Thanks for the quick check. I'll prepare a revert PR now and run unit tests locally.

Ted Nguyen: Good move. Can we add a temporary test skip for the e2e alloc shard until revert lands? We prefer revert + fix, but skip gives us breathing room.

Maria Lopez: Ops: prefer revert to skipping; skipping can hide regressions. Let's revert and push a hotfix branch to reintroduce change after tests pass.

Alex Kim: Revert PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4225 — reverting PR #4218. Marking it as hotfix.

Jonas-oncall: I'm kicking off a rerun with the revert merged into main.

infra-bot: Triggered build 24367 (post-revert) — https://ci.redwood/integrations/24367

(18m later)

infra-bot: Build 24367 succeeded — all linux-e2e green :white_check_mark:

Maria Lopez: Nice. Thanks everyone. Action items: 1) Alex to investigate root cause in allocator refactor and open a follow-up PR with fixes and tests. 2) Priya/Ted to run a focused perf/regression test on allocator at scale. 3) Hold merges until Alex's PR has a green e2e or gets reviewed by infra.

Alex Kim: Got it. I'll add extra unit coverage for the free path and a small e2e that targets shard boundaries. ETA: end of day.

Priya Shah: I'll run a forced CI job for Alex's branch once he's ready.

Ted Nguyen: Thanks all. Closing the fire drill. :thumbsup:

Maria Lopez: Copy. I'll update the release channel and remove the code freeze in ~30m.
